title: Extension of last date for submission of comments and counter-comments on TRAI Consultation Paper on draft amendments in 'The Standards of Quality of Service of Access (Wireline and Wireless) and Broadband (Wireline and Wireless) Service Regulations, 2024'
body_text:
The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) issued a Consultation Paper on draft amendments in 'The Standards of Quality of Service of Access (Wireline and Wireless) and Broadband (Wireline and Wireless) Service Regulations, 2024' on 5 th August 2026. The last date for submitting comments and counter-comments from stakeholders was fixed as 26 th August 2026 and 7 th September 2026, respectively.
In this regard, considering the requests received from Industry associations and stakeholders for extending the date for submission of comments and counter-comments, it has been decided to extend the last date for submission of comments and counter-comments up to 02 nd September 2026 and 15 th September 2026 , respectively.
The comments and counter-comments may be sent in electronic form at adv-qos1@trai.gov.in . For any clarification/information, Shri Tejpal Singh, Advisor (QoS-I), may be contacted at adv-qos1@trai.gov.in or +91-11-20907759.
